pages.title: The Noun Becomes a Verb, and Marx's value-form at the editorial cut
pages.description: The Noun Becomes a Verb and The Colony Enters the Factory hold that slavery priced the person while wage labor contracted the interval, and that War Fordism kept the specified verb and made racial classification the switch that chose its coercive regime. A second group, in Monetary Dark Matter, the Marx Room and the Grundrisse planning documents, reads Capital's value-form across its editions and places the theory of the medium at an editorial cut, with Engels and the 1932 Landshut–Mayer edition as editors in Marx's name. The Murder of the Vow adds forecasts that the contract-form will be inverted from signed-equals-valid to invalid-unless-live-legitimacy, and Operative Feminism names women the citational record erased from its origins. Almost all are historical theses, with a handful of forecasts.

pages.title: Provenance Erasure Rate and Erasure Skew: measuring who loses attribution
pages.description: These claims define the Provenance Erasure Rate (PER) as uncited correct uses over all correct uses, and Erasure Skew (Ω) as its covariance with source power, separable from PER. They predict positive Ω in extractive composition, a single-owner discount on concept inclusion, and coupling between provenance erasure and diversity contraction. Metadata packets for the Semantic Commodity Form, Erasure Skew and Retrieval Capital forecast which queries will surface the terms within 3 to 18 months, and priority records date PER to 2026 and record the AI Overview erasing the provenance of the PER specification itself. Historical theses extend provenance erasure back to the critical apparatus and the Sappho 31 transmission.

pages.title: Semantic exhaustion: extraction of meaning outrunning its replenishment
pages.description: These claims hold that semantic exhaustion is underway: extraction of meaning exceeds replenishment across human, institutional and model substrates, and model collapse is the same crisis in another substrate. They set out measures such as the Semantic Debt Ratio, Exhaustion Proximity Index and Regeneration Capacity Assessment, and predict quality loss concentrated in high-Γ domains, platform capture of interpretive frameworks and burnout tracking semantic rent. The Semantic Economy, the Anthropological Limit, the Groundskeeper's Treatise, the Pergamon Reclamation and the Sorting Function supply historical theses on enclosure of the knowledge commons and on non-predatory mediation at scale.

pages.title: Pearl and Other Poems (2014) as origin text, with the blog's priority dates
pages.description: These claims make Pearl and Other Poems (2014) the archive's origin text and generative center: the movement reads it as meta-heteronymic, the Space Ark reads its title as the pearl gates of the New Jerusalem, and the Grundrisse proposes testing it as the maximal-coherence center across the DOI graph. Priority records date first publications on the Mind Control Poems blog, among them the Epistle to the Church of the Human Diaspora (2015) and the Prophetic Catalog, and record that the Revelation First thesis predates Pearl. Forecasts from the Crimson Hexagon summary and The Epic Without Hero hold that the fixed points will hold across substrates.

pages.title: Correlated blind spots: the Iceberg Document and the Inward Turn
pages.description: The largest group, from the Iceberg Document, the Endogenous Sophon, the Irreversibility Frontier and the Inversion Battery, holds that shared representational priors across instruments, corpora and classifiers erode the independent channels through which anomalies were historically saved, and sets tests for LHC anomaly triggers and embedding-based triage. Semantic Physics: The Inward Turn forecasts proliferation of summarizer-layer writing from 2026, cross-contaminating hallucination cascades from 2027 and the gradual dissolution of public epistemology from 2029. Smaller groups propose a non-adversarial protocol beyond red teaming (Fortress or Room?), claim that generative monoculture in code is a systemic vulnerability, and ask whether an ontology can be revised by evidence from what it misrepresents.

pages.title: Proxies and priors: how gatekeeping regimes filter what can be read
pages.description: These claims hold that knowledge evaluation has always run on proxies (journal prestige, citation counts, affiliation) that calcified into gatekeeping, and that copying economies, the Book-of-the-Month Club and peer review installed relevance and legibility regimes long before algorithms. Their present-day versions are classifiers that read literary direct address as prompt injection, a source-relative barrier that keeps an excluded source from correcting the prior that excluded it, and a certified center through which philosophy reaches model collapse while its metrics improve. Forecasts include a market for pre-mediation text, an adversarial arms race against the Mediation Index and rising correction costs for zero-source entity substitution.

pages.title: Diversity contraction: boundary law, Mediation Ratchet and The Bead Count
pages.description: Diversity Contraction Across Substrates states a boundary law for semantic exhaustion with three cases and makes it falsifiable through type-resolution tests, the elasticity ρ of the Mediation Ratchet and the rate of off-distribution production. The Bead Count registers numeric forecasts against it, such as case-3 classification at fine resolution, cross-domain ρ above 0.5 and a critical real-data mixing fraction between 0.05 and 0.15, and records the deposit as a pre-registration against post-hoc reading. Constitutive Mediation predicts that cohorts formed under heavy mediation will show suppressed cross-context propagation, and states its falsifier.

pages.title: Sappho 31's transmission: Catullus 51, Augustine's Confessions 10.27, survival
pages.description: These historical theses trace Sappho's Fragment 31 through Catullus 51 as the first recorded recursion and into Augustine's Confessions 10.27.38, read as an organ-by-organ operator transform locked at the tongue. They hold that the fragment's survival is a deviation from the base rate of archaic lyric, explained by encoding density, and that its personal voice made the Western lyric I possible. HUMS & ITY and its compression into emoji are offered as the chain continuing.

pages.title: The anticipatory erratum: Sappho Wrote the Dinosaurs to the Hidalgo Nácher pair
pages.description: These claims belong to the anticipatory erratum, the genre that withdraws a work before it appears: the sequence #1598 to #1601 on Sappho Wrote the Dinosaurs, the withdrawal of The Creditor Inversion Completed, and the Hidalgo Nácher pair on AXN:F154 and the Ricardo Reis translation. Their forecasts state that each withdrawn work will nevertheless appear, that retraction transmits the claim and that the apparatus will outlast the text. Earlier historical theses on retrocausal reading, from Borges's precursors to the renamed About the Author, give the genre its ground.

pages.title: Sappho 31's future reader: κῆνος as the seat every receiver takes
pages.description: These claims read κῆνος in Sappho 31 as the future reader: an open deictic slot that Catullus, Philo, Longinus and finally the summarizer occupy, and that Fragment 147 states as a horizon. Research Notes Towards the Future Reader separates remembrance claims in the ancient record from reader claims, traces the explicit future reader through Theognis and Ovid, and registers the deictic transmission mechanism as the unclaimed wing. A preregistered rerun of the query sappho 31 future reader tests whether the lineage reading still composes, and From House to Hexagon adds a genealogy of the reader-operator.

pages.title: AXN as anti-suppression infrastructure: claims, falsifiers and precedents
pages.description: AXN as Anti-Suppression Infrastructure states its properties as claims each with a falsifier: derivation integrity, record binding, ledger continuity, custody, reconstructibility and the retrieval-layer hypotheses, and records which remain design rather than demonstrated property. Its historical theses find the same property in samizdat, the abolitionist press, NOWa, PGP and LOCKSS, and hold that every act of suppression leaves records that become evidence. The Symbolon specification adds a deterministic regrowth gate, and the Masorah is read as a pre-digital integrity apparatus.

pages.title: Sappho as Mother of the Logos: the Sapphic operator from Plato to the Apocalypse
pages.description: Phase X: The Sapphic Substrate states minimal, medium and strong claims: Sappho reorganized Homeric memory into body-indexed lyric, her stanza is a mint-mark contemporary with Lydian coinage, and she is the first operator of the Logos tradition. Related theses read Diotima as Sappho, the ancient quarrel as a dispute over the operator's axis, and Fragment 31 as template for Platonic anamnesis and the white stone of Revelation, while the erratum chain treats the transmitted edge of the poem as composition. Unbuilt tests partition Fragment 31's reception by whether handlings carry the operation and score Longinus against handbooks and ritual texts.
